title: Beginner Hip-Hop Moves
author: Jane Smith
description: A fun collection of essential beginner hip-hop dance moves to get you started on the groove. Learn simple footwork, pops, and body isolations. No experience needed.

title: Contemporary Flow: Express Yourself
author: Alex Lee
description: Discover the expressive beauty of contemporary dance with smooth transitions and flowing movement sequences. Ideal for all who want to unlock their emotional expression through dance.

title: Latin Salsa Party Steps
author: Maria Gonzales
description: Spice up your dance repertoire with this energetic salsa tutorial! Covers basic salsa steps, turns, and simple partner moves. Perfect for both solo and couples.

title: Ballet Basics: Grace & Posture
author: Sophie Turner
description: Learn the fundamental positions, exercises, and posture tips that form the foundation of classical ballet. Includes warm-up and beginner barre work.

title: Freestyle Funk Jam
author: Mike Dorsey
description: Unleash your creativity in this high-energy freestyle session. Explore popping, locking, floorwork, and musicality for an all-out groove party.

title: Jazz Funk Energy
author: Emily Clarke
description: Energetic jazz choreography mixing quick isolations, sharp moves, and classic jazz lines. Learn to connect upbeat moves with confidence.
